verdict.rationale: The API reference is served as machine-readable markdown (api/latest.md), and a probe confirmed an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) that describes the API flow and versions (v3.6). These give agents parseable API documentation, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent formal schema, so they only approximate the story. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file, formal endpoint and schema definitions, and independent confirmation of spec availability.
